title: REGRESSION: InstanceStore.create() reintroduced two bpm_effective_tenant_id() calls that SPT-03 had already removed -- breaks POST /api/v1/instances entirely in SCHEMA mode
summary: src/engine/instance.zig's InstanceStore.create() (the POST /api/v1/instances handler's underlying store method) contains TWO calls to bpm_effective_tenant_id() -- a SQL function that does not exist in the live schema (confirmed via `docker exec ... psql -c '\df bpm_effective_tenant_id'` against bpm_test: 0 rows) and was dropped by the LEGACY_RLS-to-SCHEMA cutover migrations (GBL-116/123/130/131, per the SECURITY-REVIEWER FAIL comment already present elsewhere in this same file for PIN-01's own resolveServiceCatalogRef() fix). Confirmed live via `zig build test-integration-main`: every single test in tests/integration/ee01_start_instance_test.zig fails (12/12), plus a cascade of unrelated-looking failures in pd04_lifecycle_test.zig, test_snapshot_integration.zig, test_export_import_integration.zig, api02_crud_test.zig whose fixture setup also calls create() indirectly. The two call sites are: (1) line ~570 (git blame: current) `SELECT id, status, definition_artifact_hash FROM process_definitions WHERE id = $1::uuid AND tenant_id = bpm_effective_tenant_id()` (the definition lookup at the top of create()), and (2) line ~744 `INSERT INTO instance_projections (tenant_id, instance_id, ...) VALUES (bpm_effective_tenant_id(), $1::uuid, ...)` (the instance row insert). Confirmed this is a REGRESSION, not new: `git log --all -p -S "tenant_id = bpm_effective_tenant_id()"` shows the identical AND-predicate was ADDED in commit 29795e587dd6f (2026-05-26) and then explicitly REMOVED in commit 584408611586c (2026-06-05, 'feat(WF02-spt-02): SPT-03 - remove legacy tenant_id predicates and bpm.tenant_id session variable') -- but `git show main:src/engine/instance.zig` shows BOTH call sites present again on the CURRENT main branch HEAD (confirmed at lines 564 and 738 of main's copy), meaning some later merge/rebase silently resurrected code SPT-03 had deliberately deleted. Confirmed NOT introduced by this batch (WF02-batch-5-20260812, PIN-03/PIN-04/PIN-05/PRM-01): `git diff main -- src/engine/instance.zig` shows zero changes at these two lines, and `main` itself already carries both call sites before this batch's own commits.

root_cause.details: A later merge/rebase (not yet identified precisely -- the exact commit that reintroduced the two lines after SPT-03's removal was not tracked down in this discovery pass) restored code that commit 584408611586c had deliberately deleted for the LEGACY_RLS-to-SCHEMA cutover. process_definitions and instance_projections are both PER_TENANT tables reached via SCHEMA-mode search_path routing (tenant_context.set()), not via a SQL-side session function or GUC -- the same INV-1 pattern already documented and fixed once for src/engine/pin_resolver.zig's resolveServiceCatalogRef() in the immediately preceding batch (WF02-batch-4-20260811), but this second occurrence in the SAME FILE was not caught by that fix or its review.

prevention: Remove both bpm_effective_tenant_id() call sites from InstanceStore.create(): drop the ' AND tenant_id = bpm_effective_tenant_id()' predicate from the definition lookup query (process_definitions is reached via SCHEMA-mode routing already, no additional tenant predicate needed once the correct schema is on search_path), and drop the tenant_id column/bpm_effective_tenant_id() value from the instance_projections INSERT (mirroring SPT-03's original fix, commit 584408611586c) -- confirm instance_projections' current column list actually needs a tenant_id value at all under the live schema before deciding whether to drop the column entirely from the INSERT or bind it as an explicit $N parameter instead.

Grep the whole src/ tree for bpm_effective_tenant_id() as a standing pre-merge/pre-release check -- it is a dropped function, so any surviving reference is unconditionally broken code, never a legitimate call.
Add an integration test (or a build-time lint) asserting zero references to bpm_effective_tenant_id() anywhere under src/, so a future rebase/merge cannot silently resurrect it a third time.
